map.分度圆 d = mt×z；法向模数 mn = mt×cosβ；端面压力角 αt: Pitch circle d = mt×z; normal module mn = mt×cosβ; transverse pressure angle αt = atan(tan20°÷cosβ); addendum circle da = d+2×mn; root circle df = d−2.5×mn; base circle db = d×cosαt; transverse pitch pt = π×mt; axial pitch px = π×mt÷tanβ (none for spur gears). Cutting: spindle speed n = 1000×Vc÷(π×d), feed speed Vf = n×f.

map.直齿 da = m×(z+2)；斜齿按端面模数输入时，da = mt×z + 2: Spur gear: da = m×(z+2). For helical gears entered with transverse module, da = mt×z + 2×mt×cosβ. The root circle subtracts 2.5×normal module; the base circle uses the transverse pressure angle αt.
